meta.note: Mock data used for prototype UI. Route deltas are illustrative — the pipeline will overwrite this file daily.

insights.headline: China → Sweden up 4% YoY
insights.reading: Rising middle-class purchasing power in coastal Chinese cities is spilling into Nordic winter destinations. Lapland tour operators report record pre-bookings.

insights.headline: India → UAE up 11.2% YoY
insights.reading: Corridor keeps expanding as Gulf financial centers absorb Indian tech and services capital. Business-class share is climbing faster than leisure.

insights.headline: Germany → US down 6.4% YoY
insights.reading: Softer transatlantic business travel tracks the industrial slowdown in German manufacturing. Frankfurt–ORD frequencies cut for winter schedule.

insights.headline: Brazil → Portugal up 8.7% YoY
insights.reading: Continuing skilled-migration corridor. One-way ticket share and average stay length both rising — consistent with relocation, not tourism.

insights.headline: Russia → Turkey down 3.1% YoY
insights.reading: First YoY dip in three years. Ruble weakness compressing outbound tourism budgets; Antalya operators pivoting to Gulf and Central Asian markets.

insights.headline: Mexico → US up 5.6% YoY
insights.reading: Nearshoring corridor. Growth is concentrated in Monterrey–Detroit and Guadalajara–Dallas — industrial hubs, not leisure destinations.

insights.headline: Japan → Australia up 2.3% YoY
insights.reading: Modest expansion as the yen recovers. Ski-season pre-bookings from Tokyo up sharply — a proxy for consumer-confidence recovery.

insights.headline: Nigeria → UK up 7.9% YoY
insights.reading: Lagos–London corridor continuing to grow despite tightened UK visa rules. Student-visa share of tickets remains the dominant driver.
